title: Adoption Disruption Vulnerability Canvas & Field Recon Plan for Emerging Model Ecosystems
creator: Sofia Martinez
description:
Goal: Produce a prioritized vulnerability canvas and operationalized reconnaissance plan to detect and quantify adoption-disruption risk from emerging open models and model APIs.

Context: With rapid emergence of model variants and providers, product teams need an early-warning, prioritized view of where our hosted and Dedicated customers are at risk of disruptive substitution (latency, cost, quality delta, feature mismatch). This ticket scopes a research + field-recon run to map attack surfaces (compatibility, integrations, economics) and convert findings into tactical mitigations for routing, rollouts, and sales enablement.
objectives: Create an Adoption Disruption Vulnerability Canvas covering: model feature gaps, cost/latency delta, integration friction, contractual vectors, and region-specific supply risk.
Run 6 field recon interviews/mini-audits with high-usage customers to validate hypotheses about substitution triggers.
Deliver a prioritized runbook of mitigations (fallback model mapping, pricing guardrails, targeted performance optimizations) and a monitoring signal checklist for Console.
Hand off a clear set of PM/Eng design tickets and a GTM enablement brief for Sales and CSMs.
success_metrics: Vulnerability canvas covering top-12 model-edge vectors completed
At least 6 customer interviews documenting substitution intent and economic thresholds
3 concrete mitigation playbooks with estimated dev effort and impact
Monitoring signals (3 distinct metrics) instrumented in Console POC or dashboard link
research_plan: Phase 1: Internal signal synthesis - collect Console usage patterns, Dedicated capacity swaps, and provisioning churn from the last 6 months (data request: analytics team).
Phase 2: Competitor mapping - quick catalog of 8 emergent model providers with notes on quantization/compatibility and cost per 1k tokens (deliverable: spreadsheet).
Phase 3: Field recon - schedule 6 customer interviews (mix of AI-native and enterprise) and run substitution probes using synthetic workloads where permitted.
Phase 4: Synthesis workshop - cross-functional 2-hour session with Eng, Sales, Solutions to prioritize mitigations and map to roadmap impact.
Phase 5: Deliverables - vulnerability canvas, runbook, instrumentation checklist, PM tickets, and a 1-pager for GTM.
deliverables: Field Recon Notes (drive) and anonymized transcripts
Mitigation Runbook (prioritized) with estimated dev points
Console monitoring checklist and sample dashboard queries
tasks: Request usage + swap logs from Analytics (owner: Ravi)
Build quick model-compatibility scoring sheet (owner: PM Intern)
Recruit 6 customers for interviews (owner: Solutions Eng)
Synthesize interview findings and workshop (owner: Sofia)
Create 3 mitigation tickets and link to roadmap (owner: PM)
Publish Canvas and GTM brief (owner: PM)
Instrument 3 monitoring signals in Console POC (owner: Observability team)
Share runbook with Sales for feedback (owner: Sales Ops)
Post-mortem and handoff to roadmap (owner: PM)
updates: 2026-03-11: Kickoff meeting held. Agreed scope and target cohort (top 20 customers by token usage, plus 3 enterprise pilot accounts). Action: Ravi to request swap logs.
2026-03-12: Analytics accepted data request and provided sample schema. Noted gaps in historical Dedicated swap telemetry; follow-up ticket created (ENG-8892).
2026-03-13: Competitor short-list completed (8 providers); found 2 providers offering cheaper quantized 4-bit endpoints in APAC — flagged as medium risk for low-latency RAG workloads.
2026-03-14: Interview recruitment: 4 confirmed, 2 pending. Solutions Eng prepping synthetic probe harness. Requested legal review for one enterprise contract (link to drive request).

2026-03-15: Workshop scheduled for 2026-03-22. Preliminary mitigation candidates: (1) cheaper quantized model variants in-hosted catalog, (2) region-based routing overrides, (3) sales enablement talking points.
acceptance_criteria: Canvas reviewed and signed off by Eng + Sales Ops
Field recon notes from >=6 customers captured and anonymized
At least 3 mitigation tickets with clear acceptance criteria and rough effort estimates created
Monitoring signal checklist submitted to Observability and at least 1 signal is visible in Console POC
GTM brief distributed to Sales + CSM and acknowledged by at least 2 sales leaders
notes: Risk: Customers may be unwilling to disclose pricing sensitivity; use synthetic probes and anonymized questionnaires where necessary.
Risk: Dedicated telemetry gaps could delay accurate churn attribution — plan fallback heuristics based on allocation changes.

Opportunity: If we identify a consistent substitution vector (e.g., quantized low-cost models in APAC), we can prioritize a catalog variant with pre-configured quant profiles to close the economic gap quickly.
Next step: Ravi to post analytics request ticket and Solutions Eng to deliver synthetic probe harness by 2026-03-18.
